items.title: HMV closes London’s Oxford Street iconic flagship store (again)
items.summary: The British record store HMV is closing its iconic flagship store on Oxford Street in London, barely three years after it reopened. The main reason for the closure: the building’s owner wants to double the rent. There are also looming major renovation costs that would make the…

items.title: Beverage bottler Refresco wants to return to the stock market
items.summary: Dutch beverage producer Refresco is exploring a return to the stock market in collaboration with its major shareholder, KKR. If listed, the Rotterdam-based company could be valued at more than $10 billion (€8.9 billion).

items.title: Albertsons’ $9.3 Billion Claim Against Kroger Puts US Supermarket Consolidation Under Pressure
items.summary: The fight over the famous merger attempt raises wider questions for grocery retailers about store , buying power and the risks of pursuing large-scale possible consolidation in an increasingly competitive market. Albertsons is seeking up to $9.3 billion from Kroger following the…

items.title: US consumer trust in food safety falls to record low
items.summary: A Cyclospora outbreak and a series of food recalls has shaken consumer confidence and led to a shift in buying habits, according to Gallup.

items.title: Greeks Spend €26bn On Groceries Yearly, Habits Change – IELKA, ELSTAT
items.summary: Greek consumers spend €25.7 billion on groceries a year, with their habits having changed recently, according to IELKA and ELSTAT.

items.title: Kingfisher hires new CEO from OBI
items.summary: Kingfisher has found a successor for Thierry Garnier, who is leaving to join Ahold Delhaize. The group behind B&Q and Screwfix in the United Kingdom and Castorama and Brico Depot in France is bringing in OBI CEO Sebastian Gundel as its new top executive.

items.title: SanLucar enters Finland with Vegepörssi tie-up
items.summary: Spain-based fruit-and-vegetable supplier SanLucar has continued its push into northern Europe with a new deal in Finland. The post SanLucar enters Finland with Vegepörssi tie-up appeared first on Just Food .

items.title: Carrefour To Sell Some Real Estate Portfolio In France And Spain
items.summary: Carrefour has announced the sale of real estate portfolio comprising 35 stores in France and Spain to a joint venture.

items.title: EasyShop launches in 21 European countries: “Amazon’s challenger”
items.summary: Stelios Haji-Ioannou, the founder of easyJet, is launching easyShop.com, a new marketplace designed to compete with Amazon. As of now, the challenger is officially active in 21 European countries.

items.title: Norah to open first Belgian store in Diest; Hasselt to follow
items.summary: It won’t be in Hasselt, as previously announced, but in Diest that the Dutch women’s fashion chain Norah will open its first Belgian store later this year. “Sometimes things move faster than you’d imagined,” says CEO Han Sterk.

items.title: LVMH’s wine-and-spirits sales continue to grow
items.summary: LVMH has continued to see its wine-and-spirits sales improve, recording its third consecutive quarter of growth from the division.

items.title: Olvi share price drops on profit warning
items.summary: Shares in Finnish drinks company Olvi have slid after it issued a profit warning driven by "weaker-than-expected" earnings in some of its European markets.

items.title: Nestlé earmarks more cash for Mexico
items.summary: Nestlé is planning to spend another $1bn on its business in Mexico up to the end of 2030. The post Nestlé earmarks more cash for Mexico appeared first on Just Food .

items.title: PepsiCo estimates lower Poppi pay-out bill
items.summary: PepsiCo has lowered the estimated value of an earn-out consideration it may owe the former owners of Poppi.

items.title: IT outages at Ahold Delhaize may last another week
items.summary: On Wednesday morning, the effects of the cyber incident at Ahold Delhaize were still being felt. According to European executive Margaret Versteden-van Duijn, it will take “a few days to a week” for everything to be restored.

items.title: Pernod eyes higher-abv RTD demand in UK, US with Malibu push
items.summary: Pernod Ricard is launching higher-abv RTDs under its Malibu brand in the UK and North America.

items.title: Accelerating industrial decarbonisation in France
items.summary: In France, a low-carbon grid, flexible energy markets, and growing access to financing options provide industrial companies with a strong foundation for decarbonisation. The post Accelerating industrial decarbonisation in France appeared first on Just Food .

items.title: Unigrains backs hazelnuts supplier Unicoque
items.summary: France-based agri-food investor Unigrains has backed hazelnut co-op Unicoque. The post Unigrains backs hazelnuts supplier Unicoque appeared first on Just Food .

items.title: Metro Germany Launches Food Waste Recycling Pilot Project With Fly Larvae
items.summary: Metro is launching a recycling project that uses black soldier fly larvae to convert organic food waste into feed and fertiliser.

items.title: Seafood Recipe Variety Narrows In UK Over Past 100 Years – University of Exeter
items.summary: The variety of seafood recipes has narrowed in the UK over the past 100 years, as per new research from the University of Exeter.

items.title: LVMH continues to struggle due to weakness in China
items.summary: French luxury giant LVMH, the parent company of Louis Vuitton and Dior, also reported disappointing sales growth in the third quarter, due to weak demand from China. Is this a sign of a further slowdown in the luxury sector, which has been facing headwinds for three years now?

items.title: Kerry Group Opens Coffee Extraction Facility
items.summary: Kerry Group has opened a coffee extraction facility in Pennsylvania, its first manufacturing site in the US state.

items.title: Ahold Delhaize IT outage: empty shelves at Albert Heijn, limited e-commerce at Delhaize
items.summary: The effects of the cyber incident at Ahold Delhaize are still being felt on Tuesday. At Albert Heijn, the online store is down and there is a risk of empty shelves; at Delhaize, stores are receiving deliveries, but e-commerce is operating on a limited basis.

items.title: UK Grocery Inflation Accelerates Over Last Month, Says Worldpanel
items.summary: British grocery price inflation accelerated to 2.5% over the four weeks to 4 October, market researcher Worldpanel by Numerator said.

items.summary: ISN believes electronic shelf labels will be one of the leading retail technology investments of 2027, as supermarkets look for better ways to manage prices, promotions, stock and the customer experience. There is a good chance that electronic shelf labels (ESLs) will become one…

items.title: Buyer emerges for four Gamma stores in Wallonia, but not for the staff
items.summary: Four of the six Gamma stores in Wallonia that are at risk of closing are said to have found a buyer. For the 74 employees, however, this potential deal offers no certainty for the time being: the prospective buyer reportedly does not intend to retain the staff.

items.title: Greencore Continues To Grow In Q4, Raises FY26 Profit Guidance
items.summary: Greencore has raised its full-year operating profit guidance after reporting continued growth and strong performance in the fourth quarter.

items.title: Greencore lifts profit forecast again
items.summary: Convenience-food maker Greencore has raised its profit guidance again, citing volume growth it said was ahead of the broader sector. The post Greencore lifts profit forecast again appeared first on Just Food .

items.title: Givaudan Sales Beat Market View On Fine Fragrance Strength, Boosting Shares
items.summary: Demand for luxury perfumes and continued recovery in flavours drove Givaudan’s organic sales growth beyond market expectations.

items.title: The opportunities for prepared meals as wellness-first shopping meets cost-of-living constraints

items.summary: In the first half of 2026, use of the Care & Repair services at A.S.Adventure rose by about 15% compared to the same period last year. The Belgian outdoor and lifestyle retailer is now further expanding its repair services.

items.title: Tech for Retail 2026: at the heart of retail transformation

items.title: US Grocer Albertsons Pulls Annual Outlook, Accelerates Turnaround Efforts
